summary: The AI model repository and deployment ecosystem in 2026 is highly concentrated, with Hugging Face dominating as the central hub hosting over two million models, though approximately half of all models have fewer than 200 total downloads and the top 0.01% of models account for nearly half of all downloads. Platforms have diverged into distinct niches: some focus on model discovery and community collaboration, others on low-cost inference APIs, and others on enterprise-grade managed deployment. Qwen derivatives, gguf-format models, and open-source frameworks like lerobot are driving the fastest repository growth, while platforms like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and Replicate compete on cost and developer experience for inference workloads.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: Central open-source hub for model discovery, sharing, dataset hosting, versioning, and collaborative AI development; also offers managed inference and Spaces for app demos
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public models and limited inference; PRO plan ~$9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour based on hardware selected
features: Largest public model repository with 2M+ models including Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, and Mistral families
Cumulative Llama downloads reached 476 million by March 2026 per ATOM Report
DeepSeek surpassed Mistral in cumulative downloads in January 2026 (128.2M vs 124.3M)
Inference Providers tier routes traffic to partners like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and DeepInfra
Spaces for hosting Gradio and Streamlit demos with GPU support
Dataset and model versioning with Git-based repositories
Top 200 models (0.01%) account for 49.6% of all downloads, indicating high concentration
Supports gguf, lerobot, mlx, and other library declarations with gguf repos up 464% in 2026
Qwen derivatives growing at 180–210 new repositories per day throughout 2026
platforms.best_for: Researchers, open-source developers, and teams needing model discovery, fine-tuning starting points, community collaboration, and a one-stop ecosystem for the full ML lifecycle

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local model runner that allows developers to download and run open-source LLMs on their own hardware via a simple CLI and local REST API, with no cloud dependency
platforms.model_count: 500+ curated models in the Ollama library including Llama 3, Qwen3, Mistral, DeepSeek, Gemma, and Phi families
platforms.pricing: Completely free and open-source; costs are only the user's own hardware or self-hosted server infrastructure
features: One-command model pull and run (e.g., ollama run llama3) with automatic quantization selection
Local OpenAI-compatible REST API on localhost:11434 enabling drop-in replacement for OpenAI SDK calls
Supports GGUF quantized models natively, benefiting from the 464% growth in gguf repositories on Hugging Face
Cross-platform support for macOS (Apple Silicon optimized with Metal), Linux, and Windows
Modelfile system for creating custom model variants with system prompts and parameters
No data leaves the local machine, making it suitable for privacy-sensitive use cases
Active ecosystem of compatible frontends including Open WebUI, Jan, and Enchanted
Multi-model serving with automatic GPU/CPU offloading and concurrent request handling
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run models locally without cloud costs or data exposure, and teams prototyping applications using open-source models on local or on-premise hardware

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Pay-per-use cloud API platform for running open-source AI models including LLMs, image generation, audio, and video models without managing infrastructure
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second billing based on hardware used; CPU from ~$0.0001/second, T4 GPU ~$0.000225/second, A100 ~$0.0014/second; no upfront commitment or minimum spend
features: 50,000+ models accessible via a single unified API, the largest hosted catalog among inference platforms
Supports text, image, video, audio, and multimodal models under one platform
Deployments feature for dedicated always-on endpoints with custom scaling rules
Cog open-source tool for packaging any model into a reproducible container deployable to Replicate
Webhook support for async predictions on long-running tasks
Fine-tuning API for training custom versions of supported base models like SDXL and Llama
Simple REST API and official client libraries for Python, Node.js, and other languages
Version-pinned model deployments ensuring reproducibility across production calls
platforms.best_for: Startups, indie developers, and product teams that need quick access to a wide variety of model types (especially image and video generation) with no infrastructure overhead and predictable per-use billing

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance cloud inference platform offering low-cost API access to leading open-source LLMs with an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus fine-tuning and training capabilities
platforms.model_count: 100+ leading open-source models including Llama 3.x, Qwen3, DeepSeek, Mistral, and Gemma families
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing competitive with or below OpenAI equivalent tiers; example rates include Llama 3.1 8B at ~$0.10/million tokens input; custom enterprise contracts available; free $25 credit for new accounts
features: Consistently ranked among the lowest-cost LLM inference providers in 2026 third-party benchmarks
Fully OpenAI-compatible API allowing migration with a single base URL change
Together Inference Engine optimized for high throughput with speculative decoding and continuous batching
Fine-tuning API supporting LoRA and full fine-tuning on custom datasets with hosted training jobs
Dedicated endpoints for guaranteed capacity and lower latency in production environments
Listed as a direct inference partner in Hugging Face's Inference Providers routing tier
Flash Attention and other kernel optimizations delivering high tokens-per-second on popular models
Multi-modal support including vision-language models alongside text-only LLMs
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies running high-volume LLM inference who prioritize low cost and OpenAI API compatibility, and teams that want to fine-tune open-source models without managing GPU clusters

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Enterprise-focused fast inference platform specializing in production-grade LLM and multi-modal model serving with industry-leading speed benchmarks and function-calling optimization
platforms.model_count: 50+ curated high-performance models including Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, Firefunction, and image generation models; also supports bring-your-own model deployment
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; Llama 3.1 8B at ~$0.20/million tokens; dedicated deployments priced by GPU-hour; enterprise volume pricing available; listed as a top-five value platform for 2026
features: Ranked in top five value AI model hosting platforms for 2026 alongside SiliconFlow, Hugging Face, CoreWeave, and Google Cloud AI
FireAttention proprietary inference kernel delivering benchmark-leading tokens-per-second on popular models
Firefunction models optimized specifically for structured output and function/tool calling use cases
Compound AI system support for building agent workflows with reliable JSON output
Listed as a direct partner in Hugging Face Inference Providers tier for routing open-source model calls
On-demand fine-tuned model deployment allowing custom LoRA adapters to be served at serverless scale
Low-latency image generation inference supporting SDXL and newer diffusion architectures
SLA-backed uptime guarantees and SOC 2 compliance for enterprise customers
platforms.best_for: Enterprise teams and production applications requiring high-speed inference, reliable structured outputs, and function-calling accuracy, particularly those building agentic or tool-using AI systems

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.purpose: Fully managed AWS cloud service providing access to a curated selection of foundation models from multiple providers via a unified API, deeply integrated with the AWS ecosystem for enterprise AI deployment
platforms.model_count: 50+ foundation models from providers including Anthropic (Claude), Meta (Llama), Mistral, Stability AI, Amazon (Titan and Nova), Cohere, and AI21 Labs
platforms.pricing: On-demand pay-per-token pricing varying by model; Claude 3.5 Sonnet at $3.00/million input tokens and $15.00/million output tokens; Provisioned Throughput for reserved capacity billed per model unit per hour; no infrastructure management costs
features: Access to Claude models including Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Haiku, benefiting from Anthropic's $14B ARR platform favored by 77% of developers for daily coding use
Bedrock Agents framework for building multi-step agentic workflows with tool use and knowledge base retrieval
Bedrock Knowledge Bases for fully managed RAG pipelines with vector store integration (OpenSearch, Aurora, Pinecone)
Fine-tuning and continued pre-training support for select models on private data within the AWS VPC
Model Evaluation module for automated and human-based benchmarking of model responses
Guardrails feature for content filtering, PII redaction, and topic denial policies across any model
Native integration with AWS services including Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and VPC for enterprise security
Appears in 37.6% of AI-adopting cloud environments via gpt-4o and partner model usage tracked in cloud security research
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already invested in the AWS ecosystem that need managed, secure, and compliant foundation model access with minimal MLOps overhead, strong governance controls, and seamless integration with existing AWS data and application infrastructure
